research_experience.name: University of Southern California
research_experience.department: Laboratory for Machine Learning, Health and Biomedicine
highlights: Developed AI-driven deimmunization methods for synthetic binders, identifying high-immunogenicity peptide regions and suggesting amino acid substitutions to reduce predicted immunogenicity while preserving binding affinity.

Built an interactive research pipeline for HLA-specific peptide scanning and population-aware immunogenicity analysis, using FastAPI, Gradio, RabbitMQ, peptide-level score caching, and beam search to support efficient and scalable evaluation.

research_experience.name: Ewha Womans University
highlights: Led research on Fisher-guided layer-adaptive quantization for diffusion models, reducing model size by 49.4% while improving FID by 7%; presented the work at the 2024 IEIE Symposium as a co-first author and presenter.

Conducted a DDPM interpretability study using Integrated Gradients, GradSHAP, and Occlusion to analyze the model's generation process across timesteps, showing a progression from global outlines to fine details; presented at the KCC 2024 XAI Workshop as the only undergraduate-led team.

projects.name: Multimodal Entrance Detection System
projects.summary: Multimodal geospatial entrance detection using aerial imagery, street-view images, GPS trajectories, and building footprint overlays.
highlights: Contributed to DoRA-based Qwen fine-tuning and API-based in-context learning experiments for multimodal entrance detection with geospatial inputs.
Developed GPS-aware reranking across 64 candidate entrance locations, improving F1 from 0.30 to 0.59 and AUPR from 0.17 to 0.45.

projects.name: PokerBench
projects.summary: Small language model training and evaluation for poker decision-making under uncertainty.
highlights: Fine-tuned Qwen3, LLaMA-3.2, and Gemma variants using QLoRA and LoRA adapters on approximately 560K solver-labeled samples.
Built an evaluation pipeline for instruction-following under uncertainty, comparing model performance against larger proprietary baselines using Action Accuracy and Exact Match.

projects.name: TalesRunner
projects.summary: AI-powered storybook generation from user-provided images.
highlights: Developed a generation pipeline combining BLIP-based image captioning, fine-tuned KoT5 story generation, and GPT-4o-assisted text refinement.
Integrated captions, story text, and user images into downloadable PDF storybooks, validating narrative quality, image-text alignment, and formatting consistency across 100+ test cases.

projects.name: Jeans
projects.summary: AI-assisted photo editing and sharing service designed for senior users.
highlights: Led a 5-member team in developing AI features including fine-tuned Whisper for Korean dialect speech recognition and YOLO/FaceNet-based facial recognition.
Deployed FastAPI-based ML inference services on AWS EC2 with GitHub Actions CI/CD, refining speech-driven interaction flows through senior user interviews and usability tests.

professional_experience.name: RainbirdGEO
highlights: Developed full-stack features for a weather-forecasting mobile app using React Native and Node.js/Express, supporting pilot deployment and usability testing in Southeast Asian regions.

Conducted product analysis using user feedback, competitor research, and 2,000+ survey responses, creating Tableau dashboards and contributing to improvements in satisfaction scores and forecast accuracy.
